title: The Ledge behind the Waterfall
story: On a school hike, the guide led the group to a small waterfall. A safe path went behind the water to a dry ledge. Everyone put on a jacket and held the guide rope. They stepped on wet stones one person at a time. Behind the falling water, the air was cool and loud. They could see the trees outside as a soft green blur. The guide said they must leave before the light faded. They returned the same way and moved slowly. At the bottom the guide counted every person. All twelve were present, and nobody had slipped. The group ate sandwiches on a warm rock in the sun. The guide marked the waterfall on the hike card as a careful place. Students wrote one sentence about what they had seen. They agreed the ledge was wonderful, but only with a guide.

quiz.supportingSentence: They stepped on wet stones one person at a time.
